deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout request for customer EdgeHaven -> Dedicated (southeast-1). Window: 2026-05-12 02:00-03:00 UTC. Model-serving pinned to v2.3.1 (sha: abc123). Canaries: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 10m steps. Rollback target: v2.2.9 (immutable). Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/edgehaven-dedicated-rollout

maya (sre): Noted. SLO targets: p95 <= 120ms, error rate < 0.5%. Are KV-cache warmups included in the runbook? Also will we pre-warm the query cache?

sam (eng-release): Yes — warmup job is step 4 in the runbook (warmup.sh). Warmup uses a small traffic replay to seed KV-cache and prefixes. Will run 15m before cutover.

juan (cs): CS confirmed EdgeHaven ops aware of window and asked for a readonly maintenance page for 10m during final switch. They accepted.

oliver (pm): Product sign-off. EdgeHaven requested a 30m rollback decision window after 50% traffic shift. Please make that explicit in the checklist.

maya (sre): Add: Canary health gates = p95 latency, error rate, and 99th token generation time. If any gate trips, auto rollback to v2.2.9. Who owns the auto-rollback hook?

sam (eng-release): deploy-bot will call the rollback hook. We have the script:

```
# rollback example
deployctl rollback --customer edgehaven --to v2.2.9 --reason "canary-gate"
```
